item.name: Ocean Window
item.exactDefect: Reviewer14 found that the v2 object could read as a freestanding aquarium/module because a horizontal floor/table plane and long ground-contact shadow visually supported it. Repair is restricted to mounting/composition while preserving the accepted Candy Core object materials, frame, fasteners, layered glass/ocean depth and Tier-3 richness.

variants.label: A
variants.prompt: Keep the Ocean Window object itself unchanged: preserve its glossy rounded coral/aqua Candy Core enamel frame, fasteners, thick layered glass and ocean scene. Repair only the mounting/background composition. Replace the visible horizontal floor/table plane, diagonal wall-floor seam, and long ground-contact shadow with one continuous vertical interior wall surface behind and around the object. Make the window unmistakably recessed into or mounted on that vertical wall, with a shallow wall-normal recess/standoff and soft contact/cast shadows falling only on the vertical wall around the frame. No tabletop, floor support, shelf, pedestal, base feet, ground plane or freestanding aquarium reading. Maintain the same three-quarter product angle, Tier-3 richness, card silhouette and lighting.
variants.producerActualPixelCheck: PASS_REPAIR_TARGET — actual pixels show one continuous vertical wall, no floor/table plane, preserved glossy coral/aqua frame/fasteners/glass/ocean depth and wall-normal contact/cast shadow. Reads wall-mounted rather than floor-supported.

variants.label: B
variants.prompt: Preserve the Ocean Window collectible itself exactly in identity and materials: the glossy rounded coral/aqua Candy Core enamel frame, corner fasteners, layered transparent glass/jamb and deep blue ocean scene. Repair only the mounting defect. Make the unit visibly recessed into one continuous vertical interior wall plane, with the outer frame sitting flush/near-flush to the wall and a believable shallow reveal around its back edge. Remove every horizontal floor/table/support plane, wall-floor seam, base foot and ground-contact shadow. All shadows must be short contact/cast shadows on the vertical wall around the frame. Keep the same three-quarter collectible camera, clean card silhouette, controlled Tier-3 lighting and no text/UI.
variants.producerActualPixelCheck: PASS_REPAIR_TARGET_PREFERRED — actual pixels preserve the exact Ocean Window identity and Candy Core material system while replacing the floor/table support read with a continuous vertical wall and short left/lower wall-cast shadow. The shallow side reveal and three-quarter frame thickness make the mount physically credible and card-readable.

selectionReason: Variant B is preferred from actual-pixel comparison because its mounting read is cleaner and more architectural: no horizontal support plane remains, the left-side frame depth is clear, and the lower shadow reads as a short wall-cast shadow rather than ground contact. Variant A is retained as a provenance-preserved alternate.

staging.blocker: The Adobe outputs are remotely inspectable and Variant A was independently byte-probed by the public browser, but this runtime cannot materialize the browser-isolated downloaded PNG into the GitHub/container byte path. Browser project credits were exhausted before a second-candidate byte export. No approximate reconstruction, re-encode, fake readback, or self-approval was substituted.

handoff: 05 next run: materialize exact selected Variant B PNG bytes, stage/read back/decode at the intended versioned path, render real Store card/detail pixels, and then route only that exact repository hash to reviewer14. Do not review it yourself and do not open Wall9-12 until reviewer14 dispositions Wall8 v3. Reviewer14/08 must ignore this remote-only candidate until exact repository bytes and render evidence exist.
